verdict.rationale: Gide's Venture & Growth Tech practice covers entrepreneurs 'from fundraising to exit' and drafts financing documentation 'from seed capital to IPOs'. However, nothing in the evidence documents company formation work: incorporation, charter or bylaws drafting, initial board consents, or founder stock purchases. Financing, M&A and management-package work is adjacent and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice
